name: DayBetter P0C6 Home Assistant Integration
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p /home/vscode/.local/bin && uv venv --seed /home/vscode/.venv && uv pip install --python /home/vscode/.venv/bin/python pytest pytest-asyncio aiohttp voluptuous ruff homeassistant home-assistant-frontend mutagen ha-ffmpeg numpy rf-protocols infrared-protocols aiohasupervisor radios PyTurboJPEG pymicro-vad pyspeex-noise && uv pip install --python /home/vscode/.venv/bin/python $(/home/vscode/.venv/bin/python -c "import json, pathlib, homeassistant; print(' '.join(json.loads((pathlib.Path(homeassistant.__file__).parent / 'components/conversation/manifest.json').read_text())['requirements']))")
